inference_input_scope: heat wrapper input; timing fields are used only after checkpoint inference

current_burned_state_provenance.construction: arrival_time_hours <= elapsed hours at cutoff, restricted by retrospective arrival validity

retrospective_input_limitation: Current burned-area input is reconstructed from retrospective arrival-time/final-extent data. Restricting tensor timestamps does not make this an operational live forecast validation.
forecast_scope: Existing burning inferred from past point arrival and reference-fuel residence, plus predicted new-ignition radiation

initial_burning_scenario.rule: known already-burned cell is active iff arrival_s <= cutoff_s < arrival_s + duration_s
initial_burning_scenario.unknown_age_policy: unknown activity and remaining duration retained as NaN on known burned cells with missing arrivals
initial_burning_scenario.missing_cumulative_state_policy: existing burning included only on known already-burned support; zeros outside that support denote exclusion, not observed inactivity
initial_burning_scenario.future_arrival_policy: future and unburned arrival entries are ignored when inferring existing burning
initial_burning_scenario.arrival_uncertainty: retrospective nominal arrivals used; kriging standard deviations are not integrated
initial_burning_scenario.interpretation: deterministic point-scale front scenario, not observed active flames or coarse-cell traversal

missing_probability_policy: Unknown new-ignition probabilities remain NaN. Their nonnegative contribution is bounded by q=0 and q=1 under the specified arrival and combustion assumptions. Missing ages on known already-burned cells leave existing activity unresolved, bounded by remaining duration in [0,T]. Neither bound is an observed value.
known_source_heat_meaning: Finite contribution from known new-ignition probabilities and known existing-burning scenarios; not the full expected heat field
bound_scope: Supplied source grid only, with specified conditional source strength and ignition-time assumptions. Existing burning is restricted to known already-burned support; hidden existing fire under missing cumulative-state coverage and exterior fire sources are omitted.

fuel_source_provenance.physical_definition: reference dry fuelbed loading, not measured event-date available fuel
fuel_source_provenance.partial_coverage_policy: retain mapped-part mean; reject as whole-cell combustion input unless explicit fallback is supplied
fuel_source_provenance.fallback_policy: caller loading describes unmapped fraction: coverage*mapped_mean + (1-coverage)*fallback; unreadable mapped mean or coverage uses fallback for entire cell
fuel_source_provenance.zero_bound_policy: zero for unknown data is a nonnegative mathematical lower bound, not an observed or assumed zero fuel load
fuel_source_provenance.ecological_limitations: no automatic biome-to-mass, canopy-to-mass, or moisture damping; consumption fraction, heat yield and duration remain caller assumptions

flame_residence_time_provenance.equation: sigma_ft_inv = sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv**2) / sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv); duration_s = 384 * 60 / sigma_ft_inv
flame_residence_time_provenance.meaning: point-scale passing surface-fire flaming-front residence time
limitations: excludes indefinite trailing burning and smouldering
does not determine coarse-cell traversal time or subcell flame positions
does not establish arrival time or an active-flame observation

source_tags.units: official encoded product value; consult product legend

fuel_catalog.location: table 7, p.18; constants p.17; code assignment table 1, p.5

flame_residence_time_provenance.dynamic_curing: characteristic SAV invariant because transferred herbaceous load preserves SAV (Scott and Burgan p.6)
flame_residence_time_provenance.gs4_source_note: table 7 parameters imply approximately 1631 ft^-1, consistent with Andrews table 8c; Scott and Burgan GS4 summary reports 1674 ft^-1

illustrative_parameters.burning_duration_s: per-cell FBFM40 characteristic-SAV residence, with explicit fallback scenario
illustrative_parameters.residence_spatial_assumption: representative point-scale front duration assigned to each 375 m cell; no cell-traversal timing is inferred
illustrative_parameters.conditional_ignition_time: Uniform over next hour given ignition occurs
illustrative_parameters.flaming_duration_limitation: excludes smouldering, crown fire, reignition, and indefinite trailing combustion

ecology_vs_uniform_identical_probability.shared_inputs: same new-burn probabilities, already-burned mask, past arrival times, cutoff, arrival validity, and per-cell residence durations
ecology_vs_uniform_identical_probability.interpretation: Sensitivity to reference spatial fuel loading; no measured accuracy improvement is established

pipeline_metadata.heat_flux_semantics: interval-mean incident radiant flux in W/m2
pipeline_metadata.dose_semantics: integral of interval-mean radiant flux over forecast interval in J/m2
pipeline_metadata.scope: newly igniting cells plus existing burning under supplied arrival and duration scenario
pipeline_metadata.arrival_time_assumption: conditional on a first-new-burning event, arrival is uniform within the hour
pipeline_metadata.burning_profile_assumption: constant conditional HRR for the supplied residence duration after arrival
pipeline_metadata.present_burning_assumption: activity inferred from past arrival and supplied duration on known already-burned cells
pipeline_metadata.activity_interval: [arrival_time_s, arrival_time_s + burning_duration_s); inactive at exact extinction
pipeline_metadata.unknown_probability_policy: full expectation is NaN when emitting-source activity is unresolved; nonnegative-source endpoints yield bounds
pipeline_metadata.unknown_current_age_policy: remaining duration in [0,T]; mean occupancy upper min(T/D,1); endpoint upper 1 if T>D, otherwise 0
pipeline_metadata.bounds_scope: fixed supplied combustion, duration, geometry, and finite source domain; existing fire restricted to known already-burned support; excludes existing fire hidden by unknown cumulative state, omitted transport and parameter uncertainty

predictor.probability_semantics: new cumulative burning during the next exact hour

residence_time.equation: sigma_ft_inv = sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv**2) / sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv); duration_s = 384 * 60 / sigma_ft_inv
residence_time.meaning: point-scale passing surface-fire flaming-front residence time
limitations: excludes indefinite trailing burning and smouldering
does not determine coarse-cell traversal time or subcell flame positions
does not establish arrival time or an active-flame observation
